server.preRoundNotes: Pre-round review for today, written from the morning list before rounds. 87-year-old woman with dementia, CKD stage 3 and osteoporosis, here for rehab after left hip ORIF. Overnight one episode of confusion around 2 am, redirected, no fall. Vitals: BP 138/76, HR 82, temp 37.2, O2 95% on room air. Labs: hemoglobin 9.8 down from 10.4, potassium 3.4. Left hip X-ray shows the hardware in good position. On acetaminophen 650 mg every 6 hours and enoxaparin 40 mg daily. Plan: talk to her daughter about a discharge home date, recheck CBC on Friday.
